# `slack.status`

Content-free Slack-voice freshness snapshot: message counts by channel, when you last ran slack.import, and a stale/fresh verdict. CLI-only: pass --brief for one plain-text line suited to a session-start hook instead of full JSON.

- **group:** `read`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice slack-status`
- **MCP tool:** `slack_status`

## Examples

```
operator-voice slack-status
```
```
operator-voice slack-status --brief
```

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |

## Plain-language aliases

- "slack voice status"
- "is slack set up"
- "when did you last read slack"
